11.original: Here NLL is the optimized objective. Faint: training minibatches; solid: validation. Diamond: lowest validation NLL.
11.text: The DPO-trained student can only emit its output to a given input; we no longer have chosen/rejected answer pairs. So, soft prompt trained on the DPO student uses normal SFT, with a straight NLL training objective. Faint: training minibatches; solid: validation. Diamond: lowest validation NLL.

12.original: All six runs stopped on validation plateau. DPO can improve while chosen-answer NLL worsens; the objectives are different. Student-answer NLL uses different targets and is not directly comparable to teacher-preference NLL.
